content: Malongi ma bakhaka
Bafwadisi yi ndambu ya balongi ba mitsiku bátuka ku Yelusalemi bisa kutakana kuna kakala Yesu.
Babati mona ni ndambu ya balonguki bandi bekina dya yi moku ma mvindu, disongidila ni makonda kusukula
Mukuma Bafwadisi yi Bayuta boosu bisiku dya kedi konda kusukula moku, kikuma bisimya zitisa mikuku mya bakhaka;
amana tangwa batukini ku zandu, bisiku dya lwesi kunima dya kudisemisa. Bisi zitisa lawu mikuku myahika mya bakhaka, mu mbandu kusukula kwa makopha, malonga, tulondu, nzungu za bisengu yi [thangi
Bafwadisi yi balongi ba mitsiku bámuhyula kwena Yesu: «Kikuma kya biki balonguki baku bisiku landila mikuku mya bakhaka, bawu kudyaka moku yi mvindu?»
Yandi wubazimbwadini: «Bakavungalosi, Yesaya mboti kázonza mu kubikula kwena benu! Bwosu bwásonama:

content.text: kaasi mbundu yandi kyana yenina yi meni.

content: Lwisi losila mitsiku mya Nzambi amana ludihani ku mikuku mya batu.»
Kakala bazimbwala: «Benu lwisi toma losila mitsiku mya Nzambi ndangu lwahalaminaka mu kikhaka kyenu!"
Moyize kázimbula: "Zitisa tata waku yi ngudi waku", amana phi: "Wuna wasínga tata wandi kondilo ngudi wandi bamuhondisa
Kaasi benu, lwisi zimbula: Wuna wazímbula kwena tata wandi kondilo kwena ngudi wandi: "Kina yikhana mu kukuheka kikuma kya kukusadisa kyenina kyakutambika kikuma kya Nzambi
lwisiku sisa hika kima kya kusala kikuma kya tata wandi kondilo ngudi wandi.
Bwabuna lwisi zimbikisila ndinga ya Nzambi kikuma kya kikhaka kina lwásambwakisila kwena batu. Amana mambu mahika lawu lwisi sala mafwanakana yi mamana.»
Bima bina byisi sumuna mutu
Yesu wátela hika mulumba-lumba wa batu amana wázimbula: «Ngyukenu benu boosu amana bakisenu:
Kweku kima kyatuka ku phenza, kyakota mwena mutu kyalenda musumuna. Kaasi kima kina kyisi lubuka mwena mutu, kyakina kyisi musumuna. [
Yuka ni matu ma kuyukila lwenina mawu, yukenu mboti.»]
Buna kásisa mulumba-lumba wa batu, kávutuka ku nzu, balonguki bandi bámuhyula thendula ya kingana kina.
Yandi wubazimbwadini: «Benu phi lweku yi ngangu? Lwisiku zaya ni heku kima kya ku phenza, kikoti mwena mutu kyalenda musumuna,
mukuma kyawu kyisiku kota ku mbundu yandi; kaasi mu kundu dyandi, ku thwala kukwenda mu kabini?» Muna ndinga meni zina, mwamuna Yesu kakala zimbwala ni madya moosu ma kasemi menina.
Kakala zimbula hika: «Kina kyisi lubuka mwena mutu kyakina kyisi musumuna.
Mukuma muna mbundu ya mutu, mwamuna mwisi tuka mabanza mambi: kindumba kya kisaka-saka, bwifi, khengu,
mbongi, lukusu, khu, nduka za mbi, bizumba, ngusi, kukenga mesu, kuhuna musamu, lulendu, kukonda kubakisa mambu.
Mambu mama moosu mambi myisi lubuka mu kati dya mutu amana myisi sumuna mutu.»
Lukwikilu lwa mukhetu mosi wa munzenza
Buna kákatuka Yesu hahana, wénda ku kinzunga kya Tidi. Wákota muna nzu yimosi, kátondaku ni bamuzaya kwena mutu; kaasi kálendaku mu kuswama.
Muna tangwa meni dina mukhetu mosi, mwana wandi wa mukhetu kákala yi kitembu kya mbi kimosi. Buna káyuka kuzonzila Yesu, wisa dilosa muna malu mandi.
Mukhetu meni wuna kákalaku Muyuta, mwisi Silo-Fenisi kákala. Kakala mubokwadila ni kakukwasa kitembu kya mbi kina kya mwana wandi.
Kaasi Yesu kakala muzimbwala: «Yambula theti bana bayukuta; mukuma ka mboti ku mu kutambula madya ma bana, amana batimbulama kwena bambwa.»
Kaasi mukhetu kámuvutwala: «Pfumu, aketi bambwa phi bisi dya bizotu bina bisi bwisisa bana mu tsya mesa.»
Yandi wumuzimbwadini: «Kikuma kya ndinga yina, vutuka ku nzu yaku, kitembu kya mbi kilubukini mwena mwana waku wa mukhetu.»
Tangwa kávutuka ku nzu yandi, káwana mwana walandalala hana thangi, kitembu kya mbi kilubuki kedi.
Yesu wubeludi muhunga mosi
Buna kálubuka ku kinzunga kya Tidi, wáhitila ku Sitoni amana wávutwakila ku yanga dya mbuta dya Ngadidi, wáhitila mu kinzunga kya Mbanza Kumi.
Bámunatina muhunga mosi wákala babakana mu kuzonza; amana bámubokwadila ni kamusya moku.
Yesu wámunata ku kingenga kyana yi mulumba-lumba wa batu; wámusya milembu myandi muna matu, wálokula metya amana wámusimba lulaka yi metya mandi.
Kunima wásekula mesu kuna zilu, wáhumwakina amana wázimbula kwena kahuwa: «Efwata!» Disongidila: "Kanguka!"
Muna mbala mosi, matu ma mutu wuna mákanguka, lulaka lwandi lwákutumuka, wáyandika mu kuzonza buna bwa bukheti.
Yesu wábakandikisa ni bazonzilabwoku kwena mutu; kaasi mbatanana kábakandisabwa, báyadingisawa hika lawu, musamu, kuluta.
Batu báyituka lawu, bakala zimbula: «Moosu kabati hanga menina ma bukheti lawu! Kabati yukisa tuhuwa yi kuzonzisa mihunga!»

Kaasi Bulunda bwa khulu bwákalaku zimbula ni bwabuna bwakala mboti mu kusukulaka moku ku thwala ya madya moosu ndangu Nzambi katambwasa.
Muna masonuku mahika, muhowu wawu thangi weninamwoku.
Kul 20:12; Klg 5:16 yi Kul 21:17 yi Lev 20:9
Bayuta bakala yi kikalulu kya kuhanaka bima kikuma kya kisalu kya Nzambi. Yuka ni balambudi kima kikuma kya kisalu kya Nzambi, bafwanikyoku basadila hika mu mutindu wukwawu.
Nzila ya mukanda yayi yenamwoku muna masonuku ma lawu mana ma khulu.
